public_rationale: Mistral's February 26 announcement confirms a new Microsoft distribution arrangement within the preceding two weeks. That supports the ordinary reading that Microsoft was adding an AI relationship beyond OpenAI. 'Starts' is loose wording: Microsoft's November 2023 Inworld announcement shows that such relationships were not entirely new.
limitations: The evidence establishes one qualifying February arrangement.
It does not support a first-ever partnership claim or establish that Microsoft was withdrawing from OpenAI.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Microsoft has begun partnering with AI startups other than OpenAI.

statement.document_title: The last two weeks at OpenAI

our_interpretation: The ordinary reading of the metaphor is that Microsoft announced a new commercial AI relationship beyond OpenAI during this period.
One concrete new partnership can establish the development described by the generic plural 'other startups.'
This does not establish that Microsoft had never previously partnered with another AI startup, or that it ended its OpenAI relationship.
criteria.support_condition: A dated announcement establishes a new Microsoft partnership or substantial new commercial arrangement with an AI startup other than OpenAI during the target period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The purported relationship was merely speculation, involved no Microsoft partnership or commercial arrangement, or was not announced or begun during the target period.
